name: Return to Quinn
summary: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick waits for a draught that may let him travel again. Apothecary Renferrel sends you from the Sepulcher with the mixture, while Quinn remains wounded in dangerous country.

sections.title: A Bitter Draught
sections.body: After you gather wild beast hearts for the Royal Apothecary Society, Apothecary Renferrel brews a restorative draught for Quinn Yorick at the Sepulcher. He hands it over without ceremony and returns to his secret alchemical research. You carry the mixture back into the wilderness.

sections.title: Respite at the Ivar Patch
sections.body: At the ruined Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick hides beside his sister, Deathstalker Rane Yorick. The ghoul Ivar the Foul wounded him so badly he cannot cross hostile ground. Quinn drinks the draught as soon as you arrive. It restores enough strength for him to travel in time, though danger still surrounds the farmstead, with Ivar lurking nearby.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick is sheltering at the abandoned Ivar Patch in northern Silverpine Forest, well north of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Who made the potion for Quinn?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel brewed Quinn's potion at the Sepulcher for the Royal Apothecary Society, using wild beast hearts gathered in the forest.

faq.q: Why was Quinn unable to move on his own?
faq.answer: Quinn was badly mauled by the ghoul Ivar the Foul while scouting with his sister, leaving him unable to move without Rane's help and medicine.

faq.q: What happens after giving Quinn the potion?
aliases: what next after return to quinn
faq.answer: The draught restores Quinn's strength enough for him to travel, and he can prepare to strike back at Ivar the Foul, who threatens their position.
Quinn's sister is Deathstalker Rane Yorick. She stayed beside him at the Ivar Patch to protect him and help them survive.

faq.q: Does Apothecary Renferrel care about Quinn's fate?
faq.answer: Renferrel shows little personal concern for Quinn. He gives you the draught, then returns to his secret research for the Royal Apothecary Society.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see how the Royal Apothecary Society's restorative mixtures help the Dark Lady's scouts keep working in hostile terrain.
As a member of the Horde, you know stranded scouts need help to secure the Horde's foothold in Silverpine Forest against feral worgen packs.
As a Rogue, you know how dangerous reconnaissance can be when pack predators catch operatives of the Deathstalkers off guard.
